news.title: The FCC Covered List: National Security, Economic Policy, and Technology Supply Chains
news.summary_en: The FCC’s Covered List has expanded beyond specific high-risk suppliers to restrict entire categories of foreign-produced technology. What does this shift mean for U.S. national security, domestic businesses, and global technology supply chains?

news.title: No Front Lines: A Decision Guide for Companies Caught in Conflict
news.summary_en: Companies that never considered themselves defense companies are now on the front lines. This report explores how companies can navigate the fog of conflict and mitigate risks, as well as how the U.S. government can assess and reduce the threats they face.

news.title: Did the United States and Russia Just Agree to Collaborate on Data Centers?
news.summary_en: A joint data center proposed as part of broader negotiations between the United States and Russia poses a substantive threat to U.S. national security. Congress should play a vital role in scrutinizing the idea before it becomes a reality.

news.title: Ukraine and South Korea’s Diplomatic Dispute Deepens | State of Play
news.summary_en: Victor Cha explains why the diplomatic dispute between South Korea and Ukraine over President Volodymyr Zelensky’s public disclosure that Kyiv had transferred two North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul has deepened, and what both sides may want out of it.
